notes.title: Killing Floor 3 Server Only Update - Hydra Error 5 Fix Deployed
notes.notes: [p]We've made a server update for Killing Floor 3 that should remove the condition where players were experiencing Hydra Error 5 during the Boss wave.[/p][p][/p][p]As players start new sessions as of this point, they should load into the newly updated server environment. There is no client download involved.[/p]

notes.title: Hydra Error 5 Update - Fix expected early next week
notes.notes: [p]As we approach the weekend, we want to update everyone on our progress regarding the Hydra 5 error that some players have reported during Boss Fights. We are now confident that we have developed a fix to address these issues, and we will prioritize releasing the first part of the fix to players early next week, ahead of the next Hotfix. We appreciate all the community reports and additional details you have shared with us. Thank you for your continued support![/p]

notes.notes:
[p][img src="https://media.tripwirecdn.com/kf3/kf3hotfix.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Version [/b]1.0.0.6[/h3][p]We are actively investigating performance as a primary concern. Our goal is to implement fixes that address identified issues within upcoming hotfixes and releases, while ensuring that any optimizations provide a consistent and stable gameplay experience through thorough testing and iteration.[/p][h3][b]Release Date:[/b] August 15th, 2025[/h3][h2]Free Creds for Item Shop[/h2][list][*][p]To show our appreciation for your patience as we release these hotfixes for a more stable experience, we are granting all players a [b]free 500 Creds[/b]. These will be added to your accounts upon logging in after this update.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][list][*][p][b]Performance Optimization[/b][/p][list][*][p]Improved performance related to masked materials on foliage.[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized framerate spikes related to Siren Scream Shockwaves.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Matchmaking[/b][/p][list][*][p]Resolved issues where players would get stuck indefinitely searching for a match. If players still encounter this, please let us know via our investigation thread here so we can dive into any remaining cases: [url="https://forums.tripwireinteractive.com/index.php?threads/infinite-matchmaking-investigation-thread.2343253/"]https://forums.tripwireinteractive.com/index.php?threads/infinite-matchmaking-investigation-thread.2343253/[/url][/p][/*][*][p]Dedicated South African servers have been added to improve latency in the region.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved matchmaking prioritization to better select regional servers based on player connection location.[/p][list][*][p][i]Note: We are continuing to investigate solutions for client-to-game server connection latency issues, even when connected to the appropriate local region data center.[/i][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Addressed errors on servers in which clients remain connected to inactive server sessions.[/p][/*][*][p]Addressed server stability issues that don’t recover cleanly after termination.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Gameplay & UI[/b][/p][list][*][p]Corrected an issue where Impaler attack VFX would improperly replicate and play infinitely when parties split across the map.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Visuals[/b][/p][list][*][p]Continued to improve the visual behavior of shadows incorrectly rendering on large Zeds.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed visual issues with Zeds affected by the Enfeeble incapacitation. [/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Hotfix 3 and Beyond Preview[/h2][p]Following Hotfix 2, the team is already working towards Hotfix 3 and beyond. A short, non exhaustive, WIP list of items being worked on (all items subject to move as work continues) includes:[/p][list][*][p]Overall Performance & Stability[/p][list][*][p]UI Performance Improvements[/p][/*][*][p]VFX Performance Improvements[/p][/*][*][p]Improve performance for when Medic bag(s) are on screen[/p][/*][*][p]Improving client stability, with a focus around certain hardware combinations[/p][/*][*][p]Optimization to network traffic to reduce cases where players experience latency issues, even when connected to the appropriate local region data center.[/p][/*][*][p]Fix for players ending up in a seemingly de-synced state from the server with jittery movement even when connected to the appropriate local region data center.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Performance spikes[/p][list][*][p]Performance Improvements for in-game resource load[/p][/*][*][p]Reduce memory footprint on splatter maps[/p][/*][*][p]Improve framerate spikes caused by blood splatter.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Matchmaking Issues including:[/p][list][*][p]Improve handling of players and servers that would end up in a “bad state” which would result in players being unable to matchmake[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]And other critical issues & Improvements such as:[/p][list][*][p]Saving player data more often so impact of leaving a match early is minimized[/p][/*][*][p]A fix for dead headless Zeds that would show up when players Joined In Progress[/p][/*][*][p]Fix for holding sprint and running will not resume sprinting if you ADS and shoot a few rounds[/p][/*][*][p]Fix for more than 6 players being put into a game[/p][/*][*][p]Fix for explosive rounds sometimes not working on clots and cysts[/p][/*][*][p]Fix for ammo being consumed from the reserve instead of the primary magazine[/p][/*][*][p]Fix for gameplay inputs breaking (especially around throw dosh and melee gameplay - We are looking for help finding good replications of these events)[/p][/*][*][p]Improvements for medic darts tracking to the intended healing target[/p][/*][*][p]Fix for not being able to load profile or into a match when a player has crafted a certain amount of mods and saved custom weapons[/p][/*][*][p]Fix daily objectives not completing for some players[/p][/*][*][p]Perk Skill Menu soft locking under some conditions[/p][/*][*][p]Defaulting Frame Cap to Unlimited (Players will need to manually change or reset to default if they have previously played the game)[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p]

notes.title: KF 3 Community Update: A Celebration Of Gloom, Grime, Grunge, and Grit
notes.notes:
Hi, everyone!

With this most recent pass, we set out to craft a living nightmare, a world whose every surface speaks of pain, toil, and terror. And it's much larger than just our maps—we've also applied the 4Gs to our characters, outfits, and weapons.

[previewyoutube=4BrZt9fjGI0;full][/previewyoutube]


Medics, take note: the VS-11 (seen in the video above) and K&W MP6 now come with the healing dart mod by default, reinforcing your role as the squad’s lifeline. We've also added some new Medic weapon mods that allow you to adjust dart behavior and healing efficiency. In addition, the Biomorphic Projector now features a secondary fire that heals allies as well.

Be sure to let us know what else you may have spotted and let us know what level you plan on dropping into first. We can’t wait to continue sharing more with you as soon as this weekend at IGN Live, so tune in and watch (Saturday, June 7th) via [url=https://www.twitch.tv/ign]Twitch[/url] and [url=https://www.youtube.com/@IGN]Youtube[/url]!

notes.title: Killing Floor 3 now set for release on July 24 after being delayed to improve it
notes.notes:
Killing Floor 3 was originally due to release in March, but feedback was pretty bad from their Beta and so they delayed it to rework various parts of it. Now, it's set for launch on July 24.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2025/05/killing-floor-3-now-set-for-release-on-july-24-after-being-delayed-to-improve-it/

notes.title: After biting a four month delay bullet, Killing Floor 3 finally has a new release date
notes.notes:
Tripwire has remerged to bring co-op shooter fans everywhere - many of whom have waited years for a sequel to Killing Floor 2 - some major news about the release date of Killing Floor 3. Now, you may remember that the game actually had a March 25 release date for a while, before Tripwire suddenly took it off the calendar without providing a new date.

Read more

notes.title: KF 3 Community Update: Bloat Enhancements
notes.notes:
Hi, everyone!

With the last community update, we covered a variety of[url=https://forums.tripwireinteractive.com/index.php?threads/kf-3-community-update-zed-combat-enhancements.2341680/] zed combat enhancements[/url] coming to [i]Killing Floor 3[/i]. Today, we’re taking a more detailed look at the bloat, seen here in the recently enhanced level, Radar Station, which features updated lighting, texture and set dressing work.

[i]All media shown is considered a work in progress and subject to change during the development process.[/i]

[url=https://media.tripwirecdn.com/042425/bloatbaf.mp4][img]https://media.tripwirecdn.com/042425/bloatbaf.png[/img][/url]
https://media.tripwirecdn.com/042425/bloatbaf.mp4


The first thing you’ll notice is the bloat's arms moving to block frontal headshots. Using this to their advantage, they move in for new mocapped melee attacks. Once close, bloats will attempt to slash the player with their claws, as well as knock them back with a devastating belly bump.

Those listening closely may also have picked up on the ongoing weapon sound iterations! Stay tuned for our next community update as we continue to share what the team has been working on, and in case you missed it:

 [url=https://forums.tripwireinteractive.com/index.php?threads/join-us-as-we-go-behind-the-scenes-of-the-creation-of-killing-floor-3-with-special-developer-panel-on-saturday-may-10.2341700/unread]We recently announced that we’ll be at PAX East[/url], with more behind-the-scenes looks at [i]KF3[/i]’s development, plus some content premieres and prizes. Hope you can join us in person, but if not, be sure to log into the live stream!

notes.title: KF 3 Community Update: Zed Combat Enhancements
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

Zed combat behaviors, animations, hit reactions, and more have been tuned up as the Tripwire team continues polishing the game.

Players will notice smoother animation transitions, new mo-capped attacks, plus the return of a few fan-favorite KF2 attacks. Zeds are also now flinching, stumbling, and entering a headless wander state where they may just cause more damage if not put down for good.

Take a look at this short preview set in the recently 4G-enhanced City Streets:

[i]All media shown is considered a work in progress and subject to change during the development process.[/i]

[url=https://media.tripwirecdn.com/041725/beforeandafter.mp4][img]https://media.tripwirecdn.com/041725/beforeandafter.jpg[/img][/url]
[url=https://media.tripwirecdn.com/041725/beforeandafter.mp4]BeforeAndAfter.mp4[/url]


Other things you may have noticed in the preview include: enhanced weapon animations—including more parallaxed movement for full-auto weapons—as well as a physics-driven camera that reacts in real-time to player behavior. (This setting is on by default but can be toggled off for player comfort.)

Let us know what else you’ve spotted, and stay tuned as the team is continuing to work towards other major improvements and we’ll be sharing more in the days ahead!

notes.title: KF 3 Community Update: Sewers Concepts
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

Big news! Our map roster will now feature 8 playable locations at launch—including our latest addition, the never-before-seen Sewers.

The Mire, a mutagenic plague, has spread through the sewers of a small Japanese town. Horzine researchers sent to investigate reported an unusual crawler infestation before going silent. Now, Nightfall must brave the depths to discover the horrifying truth.

[i]Everything shown is a work in progress and subject to change during the development process.[/i]

Sewer Exterior

Hey all, we have a quick update regarding Killing Floor 3 for you.

notes.title: Closed Beta Status Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We want to let everyone know where things are at with the Killing Floor 3 closed beta. As of 3 hours ago, keys have started to be sent out in waves to those who filled out the onboarding survey. These are continuing to go out, so please keep an eye on your email and check your spam folder.

[b]PC/Steam:[/b]
While the original intent was for this build to also come online tomorrow with the other platforms, it is active now and it will stay live until the end of the beta on the 24th at 11:00 AM EST.

Fans who have pre-ordered the game should no longer have any issues redeeming their beta code on Steam.

[b]Some activities we have seen that you should not do.[/b]
[list]
[*] Do not share your code publicly or with somebody else even if it errored out for you. They may be able to redeem it leaving you unable to play in the beta
[*] Do not remove the game from your library (non refund path) to be able to input your beta key, as this will leave you without a product after the beta period ends.
[/list]

Be sure to review our[url=https://forums.tripwireinteractive.com/index.php?threads/killing-floor-3-general-faq.2340844/] Beta FAQ available here[/url], and we look forward to your feedback! We’ll update this announcement as needed over the course of the beta.

notes.title: Killing Floor 3's Global Release Date Has Been Announced For March 25th!
notes.notes:
[img]https://media.tripwirecdn.com/kf3/kf3keyart2_1080.png[/img]

Killing Floor 3, will launch worldwide on March 25, 2025! We are pleased to announce that pre-orders are now available for both retail and digital versions, along with detailing pricing, pre-order bonuses, and exclusive content across both standard and special editions. In celebration, we have revealed the next in the series of Zed reveal videos, focused on the [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=r5hsuRpMiDY]new and deadly Siren[/url].

Like Zeds, Killing Floor 3 editions will come in many shapes and sizes between both digital and retail. All digital and retail pre-orders will include the limited timed exclusive Flatline Tactical Bundle (Flatliner weapon skin, Fear the Reaper trinket, and Special Action Force player card).

Tripwire and global distribution partner Plaion will offer retail-exclusive versions:
[list]
[*][b]Standard Edition[/b] (MSRP of $39.99) – Available in North America, includes the base game and a pre-order bonus, either the limited timed exclusive Clamefield Patrol Specialist Skins Pack, or the Flatline Tactical Bundle (at select retailers).
[*][b]Day 1 Edition[/b] (MSRP of $39.99) – Available outside North America, includes the base game, Flatline Tactical Bundle, and Clamefield Patrol Specialist Skins Pack.
[/list]

Digital Editions will be available on all major digital storefronts and will come packed with additional content:
[list]
[*][b]Deluxe Edition[/b] (MSRP of $59.99) – Includes the Shadow Agent Specialist & Weapon Skin Sets, Launch Nightfall Supply Pass, and 1000 Creds.
[*][b]Elite Nightfall Edition[/b] (MSRP of $79.99) – Includes everything from the Deluxe Edition plus Year 1 Premium Nightfall Supply Pass Access (four passes) and 3000 Creds.
[/list]


[previewyoutube=r5hsuRpMiDY;full][/previewyoutube]
[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=r5hsuRpMiDY]Watch the new Siren Zed Video on YouTube[/url]

Players eager to test their zed-slaying skills early can [url=https://killingfloor3.com/#signup]sign up for access and information about the game's upcoming closed beta[/url], taking place from Feb. 20-24. Check out the new [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4RCHPgFjXXs]Closed Beta video[/url] to get prepared.
